scientific_integrity: Matroid identifications are proved by circuit closure and projective hyperplane duality; negative cases have constructive exchange witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to simple loopless triangular graphs and the conventional skew color-change rule; historical priority may depend on unindexed literature. Finite checks corroborate an all-order proof but are not an independent audit.
title: A six-label symplectic exception to skew-forcing matroidality of triangular graphs
